entry.title: ripwire

## The Problem
Coding agents burn tokens grepping a repository and reading whole files to answer one question: *what do I touch, what breaks, and which tests prove it?* ripwire replaces that pass with a ranked, deterministic call graph — signatures at 80% fewer bytes than bodies, roughly 5% of a grep-and-read pass's tokens — so the agent gets a map before it reads anything.
